name: set_base_palette

name: race_spawn_template_entities
comment: copies the route's template entities into the entity array and clears extra slots

name: race_menu_palette_setup
comment: sets world palettes from level record +0x00 + (+0x5A)*2 (menu/event screen)

comment: copies level descriptor pointers into the world struct and allocates buffers

name: race_start_from_table_a
comment: calls race_init path with record index*0x68 + 0x7F2B08

name: race_start_from_table_b
comment: calls level setup with record index*0x68 + 0x7F2B08

name: apply_sector_light_to_palette
comment: interpolates wall light (+0x3C..+0x3E) at the player position and tints palette 1-143 and 149-255

name: shade_car_paint
comment: car paint colour from paint table * heading-dependent shade into palette slot 192+

name: draw_model_param_block
comment: packs model bank pointers into a draw parameter block

name: raster_wall_columns

name: transform_walls

comment: projects wall ends and heights; wall u0/u1 and v setup

name: draw_sector_entities
comment: draws entities (vehicles) of a sector: LOD and material selection

name: transform_model_vertices
comment: rotates/translates model vertices and projects them (reciprocal table)

name: collect_sector_entities
comment: gathers entities of a sector for drawing

comment: wall column pair; writes only when both texels are non-zero (texture first texel 0)

name: draw_floor_span
comment: floor/ceiling span; byte store every 2 bytes (half horizontal resolution)

comment: splits floor spans into 16-pixel pieces for draw_floor_span

name: blit_scaled_transparent

comment: copies a 0x200-byte buffer to palette RAM

name: draw_decal_on_atlas
comment: rotated decal blit into the atlas

column6: +0x84) and loads the player's atlas and palette
